description.value: Beckers Lodge is a four-season adventure resort on the shores of Bowron Lake in the Cariboo wilderness, serving as the primary outfitter for the world-renowned Bowron Lake Provincial Park Canoe Circuit. The resort operates a restaurant with a separate takeout window, offers rustic-to-deluxe log cabins, and rents canoes, kayaks, ATVs, and snowmobiles in a remote setting accessible via Wells, BC. The lodge intentionally operates internet-free, positioning itself as a genuine technology-free wilderness retreat deep in the Cariboo Mountains.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Beckers Lodge is an active four-season adventure resort with a restaurant and a separate takeout window on Bowron Lake, supporting the Food & Drink category. The contact page explicitly states 'We're INTERNET FREE' ruling out Wi-Fi; the lodging page describes a washhouse with showers available on-site, confirming restroom facilities. No mention of bike parking, racks, or any cycling-specific infrastructure appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone or address; phone and mailing address sourced from website only.
OSM tags only as 'amenity=restaurant' but this is a full adventure resort — consider also listing under Accommodation.
Address provided is a PO Box mailing address (Wells, BC V0K 2R0); the physical location is at Bowron Lake, reached via Bowron Lake Road — no civic street address found on website.
Toll-free line (1-800-808-4761) and lodge direct line (1-604-424-4333) also available per website; reservations office is in Quesnel, not at the lake.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active resort with a confirmed restaurant and takeout window in a remote Cariboo wilderness location; a valuable food and rest stop for cyclists touring the Bowron Lake area.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email: info@beckerslodge.ca. Reservations office is located in Quesnel; lodge direct line for same-day contact is 1-604-424-4333.
